local characters, used, counter = "ABCD", {}, 0
local function visit(prefix)
    if #prefix == 4 then
        counter = counter + 1
        io.write(string.format("%d: %s\n", counter, prefix))
        return
    end
    for i = 1, 4 do
        if not used[i] then
            used[i] = true
            visit(prefix .. characters:sub(i, i))
            used[i] = false
visit("")
